player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee leek {player_id} tɔ̈u {colour} ({piece}) ee game de Othello.
Yin ee kɔc piɛ̈ɛ̈n tɔ̈u yin ee piny de bor kuɔ̈t ee game.
Ee wɛ̈ɛ̈t yin, tɔ̈u yin ee kuɔ̈t ee kɔc piɛ̈ɛ̈n tɔ̈u yin ee wɛ̈ɛ̈t kuɔ̈t ee kɔc piɛ̈ɛ̈n tɔ̈u yin ee kuɔ̈t ee wɛ̈ɛ̈t kuɔ̈t ee kɔc piɛ̈ɛ̈n tɔ̈u yin ee kuɔ̈t ee wɛ̈ɛ̈t kuɔ̈t ee kɔc piɛ̈ɛ̈n tɔ̈u yin. Kɔc piɛ̈ɛ̈n tɔ̈u yin ee wɛ̈ɛ̈t kuɔ̈t ee kɔc piɛ̈ɛ̈n tɔ̈u yin ee tɔ̈u yin.
Kɔ̈ɔ̈c yin ee kuɔ̈t ee wɛ̈ɛ̈t '[row, col]'.

board.no_valid_moves_reset: {observation} Acïn kë lëu bï yïn ya looi - ka ba lɔ̈ɔ̈m.
board.no_valid_moves_step: {observation} Acïn kë lëu bï looi tënë yï, yïn alëu ba lɔ̈k wïïc.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Lɔ̈k adhil ya kë cït [row, col].

game_action.skipped: Raan ye gɔ̈ɔ̈r {pid} acë lɔ bëi në biäkde yic.
game_action.played: Leek {pid} ({piece}) ee tɔ̈u [{r}, {c}] ee wɛ̈ɛ̈t {flipped} kuɔ̈t ee kɔ̈ɔ̈c

game_message.must_skip: Leek {pid} ({piece}) aye kuɔ̈t ee wɛ̈ɛ̈t piɛ̈ɛ̈n ee kɔc piɛ̈ɛ̈n tɔ̈u yin ee wɛ̈ɛ̈t.
